title: Integrated multi-omics, network pharmacology, and machine learning reveal the active constituents and pharmacological mechanism of Fufang E'jiao Jiang against lung cancer-related fatigue.
snippet: Fufang E'jiao Jiang (FEJ), a classic traditional Chinese medicine formula for improving immunity, has demonstrated clinical efficacy in alleviating lung cancer-related fatigue (LCRF).
